description: This file defines a BOMUpdateTool class and related functions for managing and updating Bill of Materials (BOM) records in an ERP system, including replacing BOMs, validating BOMs, updating costs, and enqueuing background tasks.

classes.name: BOMUpdateTool
classes.description: A Document subclass providing methods to replace BOMs, validate BOMs, and retrieve parent BOMs.

methods.name: replace_bom
methods.description: Replaces the current BOM with a new BOM, updating related BOM items and costs.

methods.name: validate_bom
methods.description: Validates that the current and new BOMs are different and belong to the same item.

methods.name: update_new_bom
methods.description: Updates BOM item records with a new BOM number and unit cost.

methods.name: get_parent_boms
methods.description: Recursively retrieves parent BOMs of a given BOM, preventing recursion loops.
